contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [PLI]VL CON[STANS NOB CAES] ; R/ GLOR-[IA EXERC-ITVS]

Roman, copper alloy nummus, House of Constantine, Gloria exercitus, 335-337. Heavily worn. Obverse description: right facing bust with diadem, draped and cuirassed. Obverse inscription: [PLI]VL CON[STANS NOB CAES]. Reverse description: two soldiers holding one standard. Reverse inscription: GLOR-[IA EXERC-ITVS]. Diameter: 13.04 mm; Thickness: 1.57 mm; Weight: 1.10g
